title: Constraints Limiting Conversion of Under-utilised HDB Multi-storey Car Park Spaces for Community Uses
what_it_is: Constraints Limiting Conversion of Under-utilised HDB Multi-storey Car Park Spaces for Community Uses

sections.label: Revenue not a HDB factor
sections.summary: Revenue considerations, including opportunity costs from forgone income, are not a factor in HDB's assessment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Revenue considerations, including opportunity costs from forgone income that Assoc Prof Jamus Lim mentioned at the COS debate last month, are not a factor in HDB's assessment.

sections.label: Parking needs not stabilised
sections.summary: Parking needs have not fully stabilised and it is too early to consider converting parking spaces to other uses.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Parking needs have not yet fully stabilised and it is too early to consider converting the parking spaces to other uses at this juncture.

sections.label: Premature conversion risks parking shortages
sections.summary: HDB does not recommend converting parking spaces in early years of developments, as premature permanent removal could cause parking shortages if demand grows.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: That is the case for Clementi Peaks, which I mentioned was completed less than four years ago.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, HDB does not recommend conversion of parking spaces into alternative uses during the early years of developments, because with premature conversion where the parking spaces are removed permanently, this could lead to parking shortages in the later years should the parking demand grow.

sections.label: Repurposing under-utilised MSCP spaces
sections.summary: Under-utilised MSCP spaces are incidental and not intended for community activities, but HDB can consider repurposing suitable carparks subject to parking needs and technical feasibility.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: For under-utilised space in MSCPs, these are incidental spaces, and they are not designed and intended for community activities and gatherings.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: But where the opportunity arises, HDB can consider repurposing suitable carparks into alternative uses, subject to meeting the parking needs of residents, which I mentioned earlier, as well as technical feasibility.

sections.label: HDB email on MSCP repurposing
sections.summary: HDB's email cites parking needs, structural loading, technical feasibility, regulatory, fire, safety, location and disamenity considerations for repurposing MSCPs, and HDB would facilitate requests addressing them.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: The HDB staff, and I quote the email that was sent back to the Member, it says, "We refer to your request to install playgrounds and cloud kitchens on multi-storey car parks in Sengkang".

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: The email then goes on to say, "HDB provides residential car parks primarily to meet the parking needs of HDB residents".

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: In addition, as MSCPs are not designed upfront to support non-parking facilities in terms of their structural loading, we also have to assess if it is technically feasible to support other non-parking uses.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Aside from this, there are other considerations, such as regulatory requirements, fire and safety, building safety standards, for instance, suitability of location and potential disamenities to residents that the non-parking uses may create".

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: So, I think by citing these four reasons and considerations in the email between HDB and the Member, I think it quite amply explains what are the considerations that HDB has, and in the Member's proposal to repurpose those MSCPs for community use, if the Member is able to address the considerations that HDB has, I think we would be happy to facilitate those requests.
